## Summary

Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching `junit-4.12` in `lib/`), in package `org.apache.commons.lang3.time`, source-8 compatible (no lambdas, diamonds, underscores, or try-with-resources; uses anonymous `Block` subclasses for the "expected exception" helper).

**Coverage, all grounded in the `api/` javadoc + `constant-values.html`:**

| Area | What's asserted |
|---|---|
| Constants | Exact documented values for `MILLIS_PER_*`, `MODIFY_*`, `RANGE_*`, `SEMI_MONTH`; `UTC_TIME_ZONE` is zero-offset with no DST |
| `isSameDay` / `isSameInstant` / `isSameLocalTime` | Same-day-different-time true; different day/year false; instant vs. local-time contrast across two zones; `IllegalArgumentException` on null |
| `parseDate` / `parseDateStrictly` | Field-level result checks; multi-pattern fallback; whole-string requirement; no-match / no-patterns → `ParseException`; lenient vs. strict on `2005-02-30`; null string/array → `IllegalArgumentException` |
| `add*` (8) | New instance, original unmutated, correct field shift, negative amounts, month/year rollover + day clamping, `+1500ms` exact-millis check; null → IAE for each |
| `set*` (7) | Single-field replacement, original unmutated, boundary values (0/23/59/999); null → IAE for each |
| `toCalendar` | Same instant preserved; null → `NullPointerException` |
| `round` / `truncate` / `ceiling` (Date/Calendar/Object) | Documented `28 Mar 2002 13:45:01.231` → HOUR/MONTH/DATE transforms; distinct-object + no-mutation; floor<round<ceil ordering; SEMI_MONTH snapping; null → IAE; non-Date/Calendar → `ClassCastException` |
| `iterator` (Date/Calendar/Object) | Documented `RANGE_MONTH_SUNDAY` for Jul 4 2002 → 35 days Jun 30…Aug 3; week Sunday/Monday/relative counts and endpoints; yields `Calendar` instances; invalid rangeStyle / null → IAE; non-Date/Calendar → `ClassCastException` |
| `getFragmentIn*` (Date + Calendar) | The javadoc's `6 Jan 2008 07:15:10.538` worked examples (538, 10538, 26110, 127, 7, 15, 59, …); "below-unit returns 0" cases; unsupported fragment / null → IAE |
| `truncatedEquals` / `truncatedCompareTo` | Equality/sign after truncation to MINUTE/HOUR/DATE; null → IAE |
